function.name: create_draft
function.description:
Create an email draft in the user's **Drafts** folder. The draft is not sent: it returns the **id** of the created draft, so the assistant can open a composer with it and ask the user for a sending confirmation.

Use `inReplyTo` to draft a reply to an existing email.

body.description: Body of the email. **Markdown** is supported for basic styling: **bold**, *italic*, lists, [links](https://example.com), `code`...

inReplyTo.description: Id of the email being replied to, as returned by search_emails

function.name: get_email_details
function.description: Get the details of a single email: sender, recipients, cc, subject, date, mailboxes, unread status, attachment names and the text body (truncated if too long). Use it after list_emails or search_emails returned an id and you need to read the email, for example to summarize it or to draft a reply with create_draft.

id.description: Id of the email to retrieve, as returned by list_emails or search_emails

function.name: list_emails
function.description: List the user's emails in a mailbox as seen by the user, most recent first. Returns id, sender, subject, date and a short preview for each email. This is cheaper than search_emails: favour this tool and try it before searching. Only fall back to search_emails when listing did not help to find the emails.

mailboxId.description: Id of the mailbox to list emails from. Defaults to the Inbox.

page.description: Page number to retrieve, starting at 1, default 1

limit.description: Maximum number of results per page, default 10, max 20

function.name: search_emails
function.description: Search the user's emails with filters. All filters are optional and combined with AND. Returns matching emails, most recent first, with id, sender, subject, date and a short preview. This is more expensive than list_emails: prefer list_emails first and use this tool only when filtering is needed. Use the returned id with create_draft to reply to an email.

text.description: Text to search in the subject, addresses and body

after.description: Only emails received after this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-14)

before.description: Only emails received before this date (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-14)

inMailboxes.description: Only emails in one of these mailbox ids. Searches all mailboxes if omitted

limit.description: Maximum number of results, default 10, max 20
